breakdown.description: The finite-strain Saint-Venant-Kirchhoff model is replaced by an infinitesimal-strain constitutive update
breakdown.reason: The generated specification consistently uses finite-strain SVK quantities with Green-Lagrange strain E_GL = 0.5*(F^T*F - I) and S based on E_GL, and does not instruct using infinitesimal strain epsilon = sym(grad(u)) in the constitutive update.

breakdown.description: The stopping rule is moved from maximum principal Green-Lagrange strain to von Mises Cauchy stress
breakdown.reason: The generated specification states the stopping criterion is checked after each converged load step and stops when maximum principal Green-Lagrange strain exceeds 0.03, matching the ground truth and not switching to a von Mises Cauchy stress-based stopping rule.
